purpose: Preserve the completed 300-second evidence and independently test how the same Base-rate stationary-HPP assumption accumulates delay, queue, backlog, and recovery burden over longer terminating arrival windows at four selected capacity cells.
post_outcome_disclosure: This duration study was designed after inspection of the registered 300-second capacity results and the exploratory response surface. It may expose finite-horizon accumulation and recovery mechanisms, but it does not replace, overwrite, or retroactively confirm either completed study.

selected_capacity_cells.selection_boundary: Target-utilisation-derived model capacity; not an observed roster.
Selected near the fixed-mean offered-work thresholds; not an observed roster.
Selected as a finite-horizon accumulation case; no steady-state claim.
Selected as an exploratory stress boundary; not a site forecast.

arrival_window.interpretation: Each duration is a separate empty-start terminating cohort. Longer windows extend the same stationary short-window rate as a controlled assumption; they are not prefixes cut from one run and are not observed time-of-day demand.

guard_policy.purpose: Keep the HPP source and both finite queue buffers effectively non-binding under the registered scenario while failing loudly if the guard is nevertheless reached.
guard_policy.restriction: A large computational guard is not a measured physical queue capacity.

seed_policy.input_identity_mapping: LOCAL_WINDOW_HPP_BASE supplies only the measured short-window rate and registered seed tuple; every newly executed 300-7200 second duration cell is labelled LOCAL_WINDOW_HPP_BASE_STATIONARY_EXTENSION so the stationary extrapolation is not misidentified as an observed window.
seed_policy.reuse_rule: For replication r, every capacity-duration cell uses the exact Base-demand pairing_group_id, master, arrival, service, routing, and tie seed tuple from the registered confirmatory manifest while assigning the distinct stationary-extension input_sample_id.
seed_policy.paired_interpretation_gate: Exact seed-tuple, arrival-prefix, and traveller-level exogenous-draw alignment must pass before paired duration or capacity contrasts are reported.
seed_policy.duration_prefix_note: Using the same arrival seed is intended to make a longer run share the shorter run's HPP prefix. This remains a claim to validate from emitted arrival ledgers, not an assumption to report as achieved.

analysis_plan.primary_question: How does finite-horizon congestion burden accumulate with a longer stationary arrival window at selected capacity regimes?
analysis_plan.finite_horizon_policy: All KPIs are terminating-cohort outputs indexed by arrival-window duration. Do not describe them as steady-state estimates.
analysis_plan.rho_greater_or_equal_one_policy: Where the offered-work utilization proxy is at or above one, do not report a stationary service-level KPI. Report cutoff backlog, arrival-window queue growth, late-arrival wait, and recovery/clear time as finite-horizon stress outputs.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: After execution, report replication-level means with 95 percent intervals. Paired differences are allowed only after CRN alignment passes.
analysis_plan.plot_policy: Plot only simulated duration levels as evidence. Lines may connect points as a labelled visual guide and must not imply intermediate durations were simulated.
analysis_plan.multiplicity_rule: This is post-outcome exploratory sensitivity. No confirmatory p-value, calibrated threshold, site forecast, or staffing recommendation may be inferred.
